claims: The Masters course record is a 9-under-par 63.
The 9-under-par 63 has been achieved twice in Masters tournament history.
Nick Price set the Masters course record in the third round in 1986.
Greg Norman matched the Masters course record in the first round of 1996.
Nick Price's record round and Greg Norman's record round took place at Augusta National Golf Club.
The Masters course record for 18 holes is 63 by Nick Price in 1986 and Greg Norman in 1996.
The Masters tournament record for 72 holes is 268 (-20) by Dustin Johnson in 2020.
Jordan Spieth has shot 64 in the Masters.
Rory McIlroy has shot 64 in the Masters.
The 63 by Nick Price and Greg Norman is the official low score in competitive Masters play.
